overview:
NY-09 covers a heavily Democratic slice of Brooklyn, where the partisan lean favors Democrats by roughly twenty-two points. Yvette Clarke, the incumbent, is seeking another term after clearing her primary, and she enters the general election with a large financial edge: about $1.3 million raised and outside groups spending nearly $290,000 on her behalf. Her Republican opponent, Joel Azumah, shows no reported fundraising or cash on hand in the available data.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the money picture. Prediction markets put Clarke's chances around 97 percent. The combination of a deep-blue electorate, an established incumbent, and an underfunded challenger makes this seat solidly Democratic heading into November.
